description: Complete step-by-step trajectories to investigate why clustering peaks occur at step 0 instead of mid-sorting

anomaly.observed: All chimeric pairs show peak aggregation (~74%) at step 0
anomaly.expected: Peaks should occur mid-sorting (19-42% of progress) with values 65-72%
anomaly.hypothesis: May be measuring initial random distribution rather than emergent clustering

aggregation_pct.definition: Percentage of cells with at least one same-algotype neighbor

sortedness_pct.definition: Percentage of cells in correct final sorted position

reference: Levin et al. (2024) - Classical Sorting Algorithms as a Model of Morphogenesis, arXiv:2401.05375v1
